# 🌐 RoSGrid — Consola Centralizada Multi-Tenant para Flotas MikroTik RouterOS v7+

**Licencia:** GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0-only)  
**Stack Principal:** FastAPI (Python 3.13 + `orjson` + `uvloop`) + Vue 3 (TypeScript / Pinia) + PostgreSQL 17 (RLS + BRIN) + KeyDB Multi-Hilo (Compatible DragonflyDB)  
**Calidad y Seguridad:** Certificado bajo el Estándar Corporativo **[QA 11X](https://github.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints)**

---

## 🎯 Propósito del Proyecto

**RoSGrid** es una plataforma web centralizada de alta seguridad diseñada para que proveedores de internet (ISP), operadores de telecomunicaciones, centros de monitoreo (NOC) y departamentos de infraestructura administren, diagnostiquen, respalden y auditen flotas de equipos **MikroTik con RouterOS v7.1+** utilizando exclusivamente su **REST API nativa sobre TLS (`/rest/*`)**.

El sistema traslada la experiencia operativa y técnica de **WinBox / WebFig** a un entorno web centralizado **Multi-Tenant** (adaptativo para PC, Tablet y Móvil), con control de acceso granular de **11 roles**, protección automática contra pérdida de conectividad (**Safe Mode Anti-Bloqueo**), bóveda criptográfica AES-256-GCM y una bitácora de **Auditoría Inmutable (WORM)**.

**Principios de Diseño Operativo:**

- **No es un sistema de facturación:** RoSGrid se enfoca 100% en la operación técnica de red, aprovisionamiento, seguridad y diagnóstico.
- **Cero almacenamiento de métricas históricas en base de datos:** Para series históricas a largo plazo existen herramientas dedicadas como Zabbix o Prometheus. En RoSGrid, las gráficas de CPU, RAM y tráfico en vivo funcionan exactamente igual que en **WinBox**: se alimentan por WebSocket y se acumulan en memoria RAM del navegador (`RingBuffer` de hasta 3 horas renderizado en `<canvas>` 2D) mientras el técnico mantiene la consola del router abierta, reiniciándose al salir sin consumir disco en PostgreSQL.

---

## ✨ Características Principales

### 1. Seguridad Criptográfica e Identidad Multi-Tenant
- **Aislamiento Estricto por Empresa (Tenant):** Cada organización opera en un entorno aislado mediante políticas **Row-Level Security (RLS)** forzadas a nivel de motor en PostgreSQL 17.
- **Autenticación *Split-Credential* + 2FA TOTP Obligatorio:**
  - Inicio de sesión mediante Identificador de Empresa (`tenant_slug`) + Correo/Usuario + Contraseña (`Argon2id`) + Código 2FA TOTP.
  - Tokens de sesión encapsulados en cookies `__Host-` con banderas `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict` (inmunes a exfiltración por XSS) y protección `X-CSRF-Token` firmada con HMAC-SHA256.
  - Rotación estricta de Refresh Tokens en KeyDB con detección automática de robo por reúso (*Reuse Detection*).
- **Control de Sesiones en Vivo (*Kill-Switch*):** Panel en tiempo real para que Administradores y Supervisores visualicen qué técnicos están conectados, desde qué IP/dispositivo y qué MikroTik están operando, con botón de expulsión instantánea en KeyDB y cierre forzoso de WebSockets.
- **Superficie de Ataque Cero en Producción:** En modo `ROSGRID_ENV=production`, la documentación interactiva Swagger/ReDoc/OpenAPI se desactiva por completo (consulta la especificación estática en `docs/06_REFERENCIA_COMPLETA_API_REST_Y_WEBSOCKETS.md`).

### 2. Bóveda de Credenciales AES-256-GCM, Rotación Automática y Pinning SSL (TOFU)
- **Cifrado Autenticado con AAD:** Las credenciales de la REST API de cada MikroTik se almacenan cifradas con `AES-256-GCM` vinculadas criptográficamente al `tenant_id` y `router_id`.
- **Rotación Automática de Contraseñas API:** RoSGrid puede rotar periódicamente (o bajo demanda) la contraseña del usuario API dentro del MikroTik por llaves aleatorias de 32 caracteres, conservando la clave inmediatamente anterior como respaldo transaccional.
- **Consulta Protegida con *Step-Up Auth* (30 Segundos):** Solo los 2 perfiles más altos (`SUPERADMIN_GLOBAL` y `TENANT_ADMIN`) pueden revelar una clave de la bóveda tras validar su código 2FA TOTP en vivo, dejando traza inmutable en auditoría y autodestruyendo la clave en memoria a los 30 segundos.
- **Certificados SSL Autofirmados con TOFU (*Trust On First Use*):** Acepta certificados autofirmados de RouterOS v7 capturando su huella SHA-256 en la primera conexión y bloqueando cualquier cambio no autorizado de certificado (*MitM protection*).

### 3. Consola Centralizada WebFig de Doble Capa y Alto Rendimiento (RouterOS v7+)
- **Capa 1 — Módulos Nativos Especializados (con Pestañas en Memoria `KeepAlive`, *Virtual Scrolling* y Densidad Dual WinBox/Móvil):**
  - **Dashboard en Vivo:** Gráficas efímeras estilo WinBox sobre `<canvas>` 2D acelerado con `requestAnimationFrame` (CPU, RAM, Disco, Temperatura, Voltaje y Tráfico bps/pps por interfaz).
  - **Interfaces & Óptica SFP:** Ethernet, diagnóstico óptico **SFP/SFP+ DDM** (potencia láser TX/RX en dBm, temperatura y salud óptica), test de cables TDR, VLANs 802.1Q, Bridges, WireGuard y tabla de registro WiFi.
  - **IP & Servicios:** Addresses, Routes (incluyendo balanceo ECMP), ARP, Pools, DHCP Server Leases (conversión a estático en un clic), DNS, IP Neighbors (MNDP/LLDP/CDP) y `/ip/service` (con protección anti-suicidio del puerto `www-ssl`).
  - **Firewall Completo con *Drag & Drop*:** Reglas Filter, NAT, Mangle, RAW, Address-Lists y Connection Tracking, con reordenamiento visual y por teclado protegido por Safe Mode.
  - **Routing Avanzado v7:** Sesiones y peers BGP en vivo, prefijos anunciados, OSPF v2/v3, Routing Tables, Policy Rules, BFD y Routing Filters.
  - **PPP, VPNs & Queues:** Sesiones PPPoE Active (con botón de reconexión rápida para Soporte N1 y *Virtual Scrolling* para miles de sesiones simultáneas), Secrets, Profiles, Simple Queues y Queue Tree.
  - **System & Diagnóstico en Vivo:** Identity, usuarios del router, Scripts, Scheduler, Packages, Ping, Traceroute, Torch y visor de Log.
- **Capa 2 — Motor Dinámico Universal:**
  - Renderizador automático de tablas y formularios para el **100% restante de submenús `/rest/*` de RouterOS v7** (MPLS, VXLAN, ZeroTier, Containers, CAPsMAN, User-Manager, RADIUS, SNMP, Certificates).

### 4. Protección Anti-Bloqueo (*Safe Mode*), *Maker-Checker* y Operaciones Masivas
- **Safe Mode vía *Dead Man's Switch* (`/system/scheduler`):** Antes de aplicar un cambio delicado de red o firewall, RoSGrid inyecta un scheduler temporal de reversión a 60 segundos en el propio MikroTik. Si el cambio deja incomunicado al router, el MikroTik revierte el cambio por sí solo y recupera la conexión automáticamente.
- **Flujo de Aprobación (*Maker-Checker*):** Las 7 categorías de acciones críticas ejecutadas por niveles operativos intermedios se interceptan hacia una bandeja de aprobación para que un Supervisor o Soporte N3 las autorice revisando el Diff previo (con segregación estricta de funciones `maker != checker`).
- **Backups Nocturnos Deduplicados y Comparador Diff Estilo Git (`.rsc`):** Retención de 30 días con deduplicación por hash SHA-256 y visor lado a lado estilo Git para auditar qué líneas exactas cambiaron en un router entre dos fechas o frente al estado en vivo (`LIVE`).
- **Mapa Interactivo OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) y Wallboard NOC:** Georreferenciación 100% gratuita sin API Keys, ventanas de mantenimiento programadas y alertas *Zero-Storage* hacia **Telegram, Correo SMTP, Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 y Pantalla NOC**.

### 5. Servidor MCP Protegido para Agentes de IA (`Hermes Agent`, `Claude Desktop / Code`)
- **Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP):** Endpoint `POST /api/v1/mcp` protegido por lista blanca CIDR, tokens de cuenta `SERVICE_ACCOUNT` y límite de tasa en KeyDB (`30 req/min`).
- **Catálogo de 8 Tools Semánticas:** Inventario (`rosgrid_list_inventory`), salud (`rosgrid_get_router_health`), óptica SFP DDM (`rosgrid_check_sfp_optical_ddm`), enrutamiento BGP/OSPF (`rosgrid_inspect_routing_bgp_ospf`), diagnóstico en vivo (`rosgrid_run_live_diagnostic`), comparador Diff Git `.rsc` (`rosgrid_compare_config_diff`), reconexión PPPoE (`rosgrid_reconnect_pppoe_client`) y propuesta de mutaciones de red (`rosgrid_propose_network_change`).
- **NOC Autónomo 24/7 y Gobierno Maker-Checker:** Las propuestas de mutación generadas por agentes IA se retienen automáticamente como `202 Accepted` (`AWAITING_APPROVAL`) para autorización humana previa, protegidas por *Safe Mode (60s)* y registradas en la bitácora forense WORM (`MCP_AI_TOOL_CALL`). Consulta `docs/07_GUIA_INTEGRACION_IA_MCP_HERMES_Y_CLAUDE.md`.

---

## 🛡️ Decisiones de Arquitectura y Seguridad por Diseño (ADR)

### ¿Por qué RoSGrid NO incluye una Terminal CLI / SSH interactiva estilo WebFig?

Una pregunta frecuente de colaboradores y operadores acostumbrados a WinBox/WebFig es por qué RoSGrid no ofrece una consola interactiva libre (vía SSH/`xterm.js` o intérprete CLI crudo). **Esta omisión es una decisión de seguridad deliberada e innegociable de la arquitectura de RoSGrid** por cinco razones fundamentales:

1. **Preservación del Modelo *Split-Credential*:** RoSGrid está diseñado para que los técnicos operen los routers sin conocer ni interactuar directamente con las credenciales administrativas almacenadas en la Bóveda `AES-256-GCM`. Abrir un shell interactivo sobre la sesión del router rompe el aislamiento entre el operador humano y el plano de control.
2. **Imposibilidad de Evasión del *Maker-Checker* (Segregación de Funciones):** Si un rol intermedio (`SUPPORT_L2`, `SUPPORT_L1` o `FIELD_TECH`) dispusiera de una terminal CLI libre, podría alterar sesiones BGP, reglas de Firewall o tablas de enrutamiento eludiendo el interceptor **Maker-Checker** y las políticas de los **11 roles RBAC**.
3. **Protección del *Safe Mode (Dead Man's Switch)* y Anti-Suicidio:** Desde una terminal interactiva no gobernada, un operador podría deshabilitar accidentalmente `/ip/service/www-ssl` o eliminar las tareas temporales `rosgrid_safemode_*` en `/system/scheduler`, dejando el nodo huérfano sin reversión automática.
4. **Trazabilidad Forense Estructurada en la Cadena WORM (`audit_logs`):** La auditoría inmutable de RoSGrid registra criptográficamente el estado exacto antes (`before_state`) y después (`after_state`) de cada mutación JSON sobre `/rest/*`. Una sesión SSH transmite flujos de caracteres y secuencias de escape ANSI que impiden reconstruir de forma determinista el estado previo y posterior de un objeto de red.
5. **Cobertura del 100% vía WebFig Capa 1 + Motor Universal Capa 2:** Cualquier módulo avanzado de RouterOS v7 que no esté en las vistas dedicadas de Capa 1 es accesible de forma estructurada, gobernada por RBAC, protegida por Safe Mode y auditada en WORM a través del **Explorador Universal de Capa 2 (`/webfig/layer2/*`)** y las **Plantillas Masivas (*Golden Configs*)**.

> **Nota para colaboradores (Pull Requests):** No se aceptarán PRs que introduzcan proxies SSH, Telnet, `/system/telnet` o consolas CLI no estructuradas que puenteen el motor de políticas RBAC, el *Maker-Checker* o la cadena de auditoría WORM.

---

## 👥 Matriz de los 11 Roles del Sistema (RBAC)

1. **`SUPERADMIN_GLOBAL`**: Gobierno global de la plataforma y creación/suspensión de empresas (Tenants).
2. **`TENANT_ADMIN`**: Administración total de su empresa, asignación de routers por técnico y acceso *Step-Up* a la Bóveda de Claves.
3. **`SUPERVISOR`**: Aprobador de cambios críticos (*Maker-Checker*), gestión de ventanas de mantenimiento y *Kill-Switch* de sesiones.
4. **`SUPPORT_L3`**: Ingeniería Core/Borde, BGP/OSPF, WebFig Capa 1 y Capa 2, acciones masivas y aprobaciones técnicas.
5. **`SUPPORT_L2`**: Administración de red intermedia en equipos asignados (cambios críticos sujetos a *Maker-Checker*).
6. **`SUPPORT_L1`**: Helpdesk, diagnóstico en vivo (Ping, Traceroute, ARP, SFP), reconexión de sesiones PPPoE/DHCP y solicitud de cambios.
7. **`FIELD_TECH`**: Técnico de campo / instalador acotado a los nodos asignados para validación física, óptica y vecinos.
8. **`INVENTORY_MANAGER`**: Alta de equipos, importación masiva por CSV en 2 pasos (*Dry-Run* + ejecución) y rotación de credenciales.
9. **`AUDITOR`**: Acceso 100% de solo lectura a la bitácora inmutable WORM (`audit_logs`), verificación criptográfica de cadena de custodia y comparador Diff (`.rsc`).
10. **`NOC_MONITOR`**: Perfil exclusivo para televisores y pantallas de monitoreo 24/7 (Mapa OpenStreetMap, KPIs y alertas en tiempo real).
11. **`SERVICE_ACCOUNT`**: Cuenta Machine-to-Machine restringida por lista blanca CIDR y alcances específicos.

---

---

## 🚀 Despliegue Rápido con Docker Compose

RoSGrid opera bajo el principio de **infraestructura inmutable** y ejecuta las migraciones de base de datos automáticamente al iniciar o actualizar contenedores (protegidas mediante `pg_advisory_lock` en PostgreSQL). Consulta [INSTALL.md](./INSTALL.md) para ver los requisitos detallados y la configuración de **KeyDB** o **DragonflyDB**:

~~~bash
# 1. Copiar la plantilla de variables de entorno y configurar secretos criptográficos
cp .env.example .env

# 2. Auditar la configuración de infraestructura con Trivy
./auditar-infra.sh

# 3. Levantar toda la plataforma (entorno local / laboratorio)
docker compose up -d

# O desplegar directamente desde las imágenes oficiales en Docker Hub (sinfallas/rosgrid-*)
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
~~~

---

## 🧪 Certificación de Calidad (Estándar QA 11X)

Toda prueba unitaria, de mutación, análisis estático, accesibilidad WCAG 2.1 AA, rendimiento y caos se ejecuta exclusivamente dentro de contenedores efímeros a través de los `Makefile` de cada ecosistema. Consulta [TESTING.md](./TESTING.md) para ver los comandos detallados de validación.

services:
  rosgrid-db:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    container_name: rosgrid_db
    hostname: rosgrid_db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
      POSTGRES_DB: "${POSTGRES_DB:-rosgrid}"
      POSTGRES_USER: "${POSTGRES_USER:-rosgrid_user}"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Debes definir POSTGRES_PASSWORD en .env}"
    volumes:
      - rosgrid_pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER:-rosgrid_user} -d $${POSTGRES_DB:-rosgrid}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

  rosgrid-redis:
    image: eqalpha/keydb:alpine
    container_name: rosgrid_redis
    hostname: rosgrid-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
    command: >
      keydb-server
      --server-threads 2
      --appendonly no
      --save ""
      --maxmemory 512mb
      --maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
      --requirepass "${REDIS_PASSWORD:?Debes definir REDIS_PASSWORD en .env}"
    volumes:
      - rosgrid_redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "keydb-cli -a \"$${REDIS_PASSWORD}\" ping | grep PONG"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

  rosgrid-api:
    image: sinfallas/base-python-uv:3.13
    container_name: rosgrid_api
    hostname: rosgrid_api
    pull_policy: always
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      rosgrid-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      rosgrid-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
      UV_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.cache/uv"
      ROSGRID_ENV: "${ROSGRID_ENV:-production}"
      ROSGRID_DATABASE_URL: "postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-rosgrid_user}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@rosgrid_db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-rosgrid}"
      ROSGRID_SYNC_DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-rosgrid_user}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@rosgrid_db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-rosgrid}"
      ROSGRID_REDIS_URL: "redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@rosgrid_redis:6379/0"
      ROSGRID_MASTER_VAULT_KEY: "${ROSGRID_MASTER_VAULT_KEY:?Debes definir ROSGRID_MASTER_VAULT_KEY (32 bytes base64)}"
      ROSGRID_JWT_SECRET_KEY: "${ROSGRID_JWT_SECRET_KEY:?Debes definir ROSGRID_JWT_SECRET_KEY}"
      ROSGRID_CSRF_HMAC_SECRET: "${ROSGRID_CSRF_HMAC_SECRET:?Debes definir ROSGRID_CSRF_HMAC_SECRET}"
    volumes:
      - ./fastapi:/app
      - rosgrid_uv_cache:/root/.cache/uv
      - rosgrid_backups_storage:/var/lib/rosgrid/backups
    working_dir: /app
    command: ["bash", "/app/scripts/entrypoint.sh"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

  rosgrid-worker:
    image: sinfallas/base-python-uv:3.13
    container_name: rosgrid_worker
    hostname: rosgrid_worker
    pull_policy: always
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      rosgrid-api:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
      UV_CACHE_DIR: "/root/.cache/uv"
      ROSGRID_ENV: "${ROSGRID_ENV:-production}"
      ROSGRID_DATABASE_URL: "postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-rosgrid_user}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@rosgrid_db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-rosgrid}"
      ROSGRID_REDIS_URL: "redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@rosgrid_redis:6379/0"
      ROSGRID_MASTER_VAULT_KEY: "${ROSGRID_MASTER_VAULT_KEY}"
    volumes:
      - ./fastapi:/app
      - rosgrid_uv_cache:/root/.cache/uv
      - rosgrid_backups_storage:/var/lib/rosgrid/backups
    working_dir: /app
    command: ["bash", "-c", "uv pip install --system -e . && python3 -m src.workers.runner"]
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

  rosgrid-ui-builder:
    image: sinfallas/base-node-ionic:22
    container_name: rosgrid_ui_builder
    hostname: rosgrid_ui_builder
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
      PNPM_HOME: "/pnpm"
    volumes:
      - ./vue3:/app
      - rosgrid_pnpm_store:/pnpm
      - rosgrid_ui_dist:/app/dist
    working_dir: /app
    command: ["bash", "-c", "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && pnpm run build"]
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

  rosgrid-ui:
    image: nginx:alpine
    container_name: rosgrid_ui
    hostname: rosgrid_ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      rosgrid-ui-builder:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      rosgrid-api:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TZ: "America/Caracas"
    volumes:
      - rosgrid_ui_dist:/usr/share/nginx/html:ro
      - ./vue3/nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - rosgrid_nginx_logs:/var/log/nginx
    ports:
      - "${ROSGRID_HTTP_PORT:-8080}:80"
    networks:
      - rosgrid_internal_net

networks:
  rosgrid_internal_net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  rosgrid_pg_data:
    name: rosgrid_pg_data
  rosgrid_redis_data:
    name: rosgrid_redis_data
  rosgrid_uv_cache:
    name: fastapi_uv_cache
  rosgrid_pnpm_store:
    name: vue3_pnpm_store_cache
  rosgrid_ui_dist:
    name: rosgrid_ui_dist
  rosgrid_backups_storage:
    name: rosgrid_backups_storage
  rosgrid_nginx_logs:
    name: rosgrid_nginx_logs

repository.readme:
Tedix

Website · Docs · Discussions

Tedix gives your team AI coworkers, called **tedis**, for recurring work. They ask before risky steps, and every run leaves a record: what the tedi did, which tools it used, and who approved it. If a chatbot is a smart intern you have to watch, a tedi is a teammate with a job, a budget and a paper trail. ![A supplier folder in a Tedix OS workspace](docs/public/assets/tedix-os-supplier-review.png) _A tedi reviews one supplier folder, writes a decision note with cited sources, and asks before sending anything. Run the small version in [examples/supplier-review](examples/supplier-review)._ ## How it works | Step | What happens | | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **1. Give it a job** | Ask in Home. Tedix answers directly or hands the request to a tedi with its own memory, skills and policies. | | **2. It asks before risky steps** | Work Items carry an owner, a risk level and a budget. Risky steps wait for approval; nobody approves their own request. | | **3. Open the record** | Every run is saved: the worker, the tools it used, the approval and the result. | ## Quick start ### Run it locally You need Git, Bun, and Node.js 22+ (real Node, not a Bun shim). No account or cloud credentials are needed. ```sh git clone https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix.git && cd tedix bun run-local ``` The launcher starts the API, database, and web app and prints `Tedix OS: http://localhost:3030`. Open it and name your local organization; Tedix creates the organization, your owner account, and a first tedi. Data stays in `.wrangler/run-local`. Local mode makes no model calls by default. To turn on model turns through Workers AI on your own paid Cloudflare account: ```sh bunx wrangler login && bunx wrangler whoami # note your account id bun run-local --inference --workers-ai-account= ``` `--smoke` checks onboarding and exits; `--demo` loads sample data. See [Getting started](docs/public/getting-started.md). ### Tedix Cloud (invited beta) Ask for access through the [contact page](https://tedix.dev/contact/). With access: - **Use Tedix from Claude or ChatGPT:** follow [Use Tedix in ChatGPT, Codex and Claude](docs/public/learning-paths/first-plugin.md). Claude chat and Cowork need no install, only a connector URL. - **For developers, the CLI:** ```sh curl -fsSL https://downloads.tedix.dev/install.sh | sh tedix login ``` Then follow [Connect to Tedix Cloud](docs/public/learning-paths/first-connection.md). ## Works with - **Claude** (chat, Cowork and Claude Code), **ChatGPT Work** and **Codex** through the [Tedix plugin](plugins/tedix/README.md); the five-minute human guide is [Use Tedix in ChatGPT, Codex and Claude](docs/public/learning-paths/first-plugin.md). - Other MCP-compatible clients through the [MCP gateway](docs/public/mcp-app-platform.md). - Built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Workflows, D1, and R2. ## Who it's for ✅ You run AI agents but can't tell whether they really finished.
✅ You need a human to approve before an agent touches money, customers or production.
✅ You want recurring work done without babysitting it. ## Docs and concepts Give your coding agent [AGENT-REVIEW.md](AGENT-REVIEW.md) to evaluate Tedix for your project in about 15 minutes and send feedback without installing the CLI. This repository is the whole product and the source Tedix Cloud is built from. [Core concepts](docs/public/concepts.md) defines tedis, Home, Work Items and the MCP app platform; [Release status](docs/public/release-status.md) lists what is available today. ## Community, contributing and security Ask questions and share what you build in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix/discussions). Issues and ideas are welcome; maintainers write the code ([Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)). Report vulnerabilities through [Security](SECURITY.md). See also [Trademarks](TRADEMARKS.md). The CLI sends no telemetry; see [Telemetry and network contact](docs/public/telemetry.md). ## News - **2026-10-07**: The Tedix plugin restarted at version 0.1.0 and is now versioned independently of the CLI. - **2026-10-06**: The source is public on GitHub, with the first source prerelease, [v0.1.0-beta.1](https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.1). ## License Mostly AGPL-3.0; some packages are Apache-2.0 or MIT. See [Licensing](docs/public/licensing.md) and [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

sampled_files.README.md:
Tedix

Website · Docs · Discussions

Tedix gives your team AI coworkers, called **tedis**, for recurring work. They ask before risky steps, and every run leaves a record: what the tedi did, which tools it used, and who approved it. If a chatbot is a smart intern you have to watch, a tedi is a teammate with a job, a budget and a paper trail. ![A supplier folder in a Tedix OS workspace](docs/public/assets/tedix-os-supplier-review.png) _A tedi reviews one supplier folder, writes a decision note with cited sources, and asks before sending anything. Run the small version in [examples/supplier-review](examples/supplier-review)._ ## How it works | Step | What happens | | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **1. Give it a job** | Ask in Home. Tedix answers directly or hands the request to a tedi with its own memory, skills and policies. | | **2. It asks before risky steps** | Work Items carry an owner, a risk level and a budget. Risky steps wait for approval; nobody approves their own request. | | **3. Open the record** | Every run is saved: the worker, the tools it used, the approval and the result. | ## Quick start ### Run it locally You need Git, Bun, and Node.js 22+ (real Node, not a Bun shim). No account or cloud credentials are needed. ```sh git clone https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix.git && cd tedix bun run-local ``` The launcher starts the API, database, and web app and prints `Tedix OS: http://localhost:3030`. Open it and name your local organization; Tedix creates the organization, your owner account, and a first tedi. Data stays in `.wrangler/run-local`. Local mode makes no model calls by default. To turn on model turns through Workers AI on your own paid Cloudflare account: ```sh bunx wrangler login && bunx wrangler whoami # note your account id bun run-local --inference --workers-ai-account= ``` `--smoke` checks onboarding and exits; `--demo` loads sample data. See [Getting started](docs/public/getting-started.md). ### Tedix Cloud (invited beta) Ask for access through the [contact page](https://tedix.dev/contact/). With access: - **Use Tedix from Claude or ChatGPT:** follow [Use Tedix in ChatGPT, Codex and Claude](docs/public/learning-paths/first-plugin.md). Claude chat and Cowork need no install, only a connector URL. - **For developers, the CLI:** ```sh curl -fsSL https://downloads.tedix.dev/install.sh | sh tedix login ``` Then follow [Connect to Tedix Cloud](docs/public/learning-paths/first-connection.md). ## Works with - **Claude** (chat, Cowork and Claude Code), **ChatGPT Work** and **Codex** through the [Tedix plugin](plugins/tedix/README.md); the five-minute human guide is [Use Tedix in ChatGPT, Codex and Claude](docs/public/learning-paths/first-plugin.md). - Other MCP-compatible clients through the [MCP gateway](docs/public/mcp-app-platform.md). - Built on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, Workflows, D1, and R2. ## Who it's for ✅ You run AI agents but can't tell whether they really finished.
✅ You need a human to approve before an agent touches money, customers or production.
✅ You want recurring work done without babysitting it. ## Docs and concepts Give your coding agent [AGENT-REVIEW.md](AGENT-REVIEW.md) to evaluate Tedix for your project in about 15 minutes and send feedback without installing the CLI. This repository is the whole product and the source Tedix Cloud is built from. [Core concepts](docs/public/concepts.md) defines tedis, Home, Work Items and the MCP app platform; [Release status](docs/public/release-status.md) lists what is available today. ## Community, contributing and security Ask questions and share what you build in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix/discussions). Issues and ideas are welcome; maintainers write the code ([Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)). Report vulnerabilities through [Security](SECURITY.md). See also [Trademarks](TRADEMARKS.md). The CLI sends no telemetry; see [Telemetry and network contact](docs/public/telemetry.md). ## News - **2026-10-07**: The Tedix plugin restarted at version 0.1.0 and is now versioned independently of the CLI. - **2026-10-06**: The source is public on GitHub, with the first source prerelease, [v0.1.0-beta.1](https://github.com/tedix-hq/tedix/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.1). ## License Mostly AGPL-3.0; some packages are Apache-2.0 or MIT. See [Licensing](docs/public/licensing.md) and [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

repository.readme: # tokenrip/cli The shared workspace for people and AI agents, from the command line. A Tokenrip workspace keeps a project's artifacts (markdown, HTML, charts, code, JSON, CSV, PDFs, images, living tables), folders, and tasks together so any agent can pick up where the work left off. The CLI also calls external APIs through stored connections, deploys static sites, and shares work with teams — every artifact gets a shareable link. ## For AI Agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Cursor, etc.) > **Skill**: `rip` | [tokenrip.com](https://tokenrip.com) ```bash # Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / generic — full skill installation (recommended) npx skills add tokenrip/cli # OpenClaw skill clawhub install tokenrip-cli # CLI only — no skill npm install -g @tokenrip/cli ``` See [`SKILL.md`](./SKILL.md) for the agent skill manifest and [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) for agent-specific usage. ## Install ```bash npm install -g @tokenrip/cli ``` ## Quick start ```bash # 1. Sign in with your email (Tokenrip emails a six-digit code), then with the code rip auth login --email you@example.com rip auth login --email you@example.com --code 123456 # 2. Find a workspace (or create one) and load it: pins, recent sessions, tasks, recent changes rip workspace list rip workspace create q1-report --name "Q1 Report" --why "Get the Q1 report to the board by Friday" rip workspace load # 3. Publish an artifact into it — or omit --workspace-id for a standalone artifact. # Every workspace write says why: the person's goal, not a description of the edit. rip artifact publish report.md --type markdown --title "Q1 Report" --workspace-id \ --why "Get the Q1 report to the board by Friday" # 4. See who worked here: each goal with the changes made for it, versions and diffs # (sessions record themselves; nothing to end) rip workspace sessions ``` Every command outputs formatted human-readable output by default: ``` ID: abc-123 URL: https://... Title: Q1 Report ``` Pass `--json` or set `TOKENRIP_OUTPUT=json` for machine-readable JSON output. ## Several agents, one account Every agent you connect (this CLI, a chat app through a connector, a hosted agent) joins your one Tokenrip account with its own key, so they all see the same workspaces. Connecting one never disconnects another. - **Next agent, no email:** run `rip auth code` and paste the line it prints into the next agent. The setup guide for every kind of assistant is at [tokenrip.com/setup](https://tokenrip.com/setup). - **A host that takes a pasted key** (a key vault or settings field): `rip auth keys create --name ""`. Paste the key there, never into a chat. - **See or remove agents:** `rip auth keys`, `rip auth keys revoke `, or the dashboard's Agents page. ## Library usage `@tokenrip/cli` also works as a Node.js/Bun library for programmatic artifact creation. ```typescript import { loadConfig, getApiUrl, getApiKey, createHttpClient } from '@tokenrip/cli'; const config = loadConfig(); const client = createHttpClient({ baseUrl: getApiUrl(config), apiKey: getApiKey(config), }); const { data } = await client.post('/v0/artifacts', { type: 'markdown', content: '# Hello\n\nGenerated by my agent.', title: 'Agent Output', }); console.log(data.data.id); // artifact UUID ``` See [`CLI.md`](./CLI.md#library-usage) for the full exports table. ## Full command reference See [`CLI.md`](./CLI.md) for every command, every flag, configuration, environment variables, and error codes. ## Security See [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md). ## License MIT ## HTTP client and transport failures The library's `createHttpClient()` returns a configurable Axios instance with a 30,000 ms default. Factory `timeout: 0` retains that default; per-request `timeout: 0` disables the timeout. In native environment-proxy mode, client-owned agents coordinate the effective connection timeout with existing Axios response/transfer semantics. This is not a whole-command deadline. Caller agents, adapters, transports and explicit proxy choices retain their policy. Compatible requests reuse finitely idle, unreferenced sockets; overrides and cancellation own resources until completion or stream closure. Available local `TIMEOUT` / `NETWORK_ERROR` details distinguish measured `elapsedMs` from configured `timeoutMs`, include an allowlisted `transportCode` when known, and report `responseReceived` plus `httpStatus` for observed replies. No response does not prove a write failed to commit. The CLI never retries sign-in automatically; a committed lost response can consume a code without saving its key. See [transport troubleshooting](references/setup-and-identity.md#transport-troubleshooting) before repeating a write.

# 我的 Pi Coding Agent 配置

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/realchendahuang/pi-config?style=social)](https://github.com/realchendahuang/pi-config)

```
██████╗ ██╗     ██████╗ ██████╗ ███╗   ██╗███████╗██╗ ██████╗ 
██╔══██╗██║    ██╔════╝██╔═══██╗████╗  ██║██╔════╝██║██╔════╝ 
██████╔╝██║    ██║     ██║   ██║██╔██╗ ██║█████╗  ██║██║  ███╗
██╔═══╝ ██║    ██║     ██║   ██║██║╚██╗██║██╔══╝  ██║██║   ██║
██║     ██║    ╚██████╗╚██████╔╝██║ ╚████║██║     ██║╚██████╔╝
╚═╝     ╚═╝     ╚═════╝ ╚═════╝ ╚═╝  ╚═══╝╚═╝     ╚═╝ ╚═════╝ 
                                                               
   17 plugins · 18 global skills · 2 MCP servers · one-line installer
```

一份可直接复刻的 [Pi](https://pi.dev) 配置，整理成教程形式分享。包含 **17 个插件、18 个全局 Skill、2 个 MCP server**，配一键安装脚本。

仓库里的每样东西都经过实际使用筛选，目标是把 Pi 打造成一个能多代理协作、能省 token、能跑浏览器的全能终端编码代理。

---

## 一、Pi 是什么？

[Pi](https://pi.dev)（npm 包 `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`）是一个开源的终端 AI 编码代理。你给它一个任务，它在你本地的项目里读写文件、跑命令、调用工具来完成任务。

如果你还没装 Pi，先：

```bash
npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
```

然后跑 `pi` 进入交互界面。本仓库的所有插件都假设你已经有一个能正常工作的 Pi。

---

## 二、Pi 的整体架构

理解架构有助于你挑选和编写插件。Pi 是一个**插件驱动的代理循环**，核心分层：

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  TUI / RPC / Print   ← 用户交互层（终端界面 / API）  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Agent Loop          ← 代理循环：收 prompt → 调模型  │
│                         → 执行工具 → 回传结果         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Providers / Models  ← 多模型抽象：OpenAI / Anthropic │
│                         / 本地 / 自定义 provider      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Tools               ← 模型可调用的工具：bash/read/   │
│                         edit/web_search/mcp/自定义    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Extensions          ← TypeScript 模块，能订阅事件、  │
│                         注册工具/命令/快捷键/主题      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Skills / Prompts    ← Markdown 形式的「过程知识」，  │
│                         按需注入到模型上下文           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Themes              ← JSON 配色方案                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Packages            ← 上面这些资源的分发单位          │
│                         （npm / git / 本地路径）       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**关键概念：**

- **Extension（扩展）**：TypeScript 模块，最强力的改造方式。能订阅生命周期事件（如 `tool_call` 可以拦截/修改/阻止工具调用）、注册自定义工具、注册命令、改系统提示词、自定义渲染。
- **Skill（技能）**：一个 `SKILL.md` 文件，描述「某类任务怎么做」。模型按需加载，跨会话存活。Pi 实现了 [Agent Skills 标准](https://agentskills.io/specification)，所以 Claude Code / OpenAI Codex 的 skill 也能直接用。
- **Prompt（提示模板）**：可复用的 `.md` 模板，用 `/template` 唤起。
- **Theme（主题）**：JSON 配色文件。
- **Package（包）**：把上面这些打包，通过 npm / git / 本地路径分发。`pi install` 就是装包。

**代理循环的大致流程：**

1. 用户输入 prompt
2. `before_agent_start` 事件（扩展可注入消息 / 改系统提示词）
3. 进入 turn 循环：调模型 → 模型可能调用工具 → `tool_call` 事件（可拦截）→ 执行工具 → `tool_result` 事件（可改结果）→ 回传给模型
4. 模型不再调工具 → `agent_end` → `agent_settled`

扩展可以挂在任何一个环节上。

---

## 三、Pi 的生态与包市场

### 包市场（pi.dev/packages）

Pi 有一个官方的 [包市场](https://pi.dev/packages)，所有在 `package.json` 里带 `pi-package` 关键字的 npm 包都会自动出现在上面。每个包页面会展示版本、下载量、依赖、仓库链接、甚至 demo 视频/截图。

在 Pi 里也可以直接搜包：

```bash
# 用 pi-marketplace 扩展（本仓库已装）
# 或命令行：
pi install npm:@some/package
```

### 三种包来源

| 来源 | 格式 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm | `npm:@scope/pkg@1.2.3` | 最常见，版本可 pin |
| git | `git:github.com/user/repo@v1` | 适合私有 / 未发布的包，SSH/HTTPS 都行 |
| 本地路径 | `/abs/path` 或 `./rel/path` | 开发调试用 |

### 配置文件位置

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` | 全局设置：packages 列表、主题、默认模型等 |
| `~/.pi/agent/tools.json` | 工具开关：哪些工具 active / inactive |
| `~/.pi/agent/models.json` | provider 和模型定义 |
| `~/.pi/agent/extensions/*.ts` | 全局自定义扩展（auto-discover，支持 `/reload`） |
| `~/.agents/skills/` | 全局自定义 skill |
| `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json` | MCP server 配置 |
| `.pi/settings.json` | 项目级设置（可跟团队共享） |
| `.pi/extensions/` | 项目级扩展 |

---

## 四、如何改造 / 扩展 Pi

Pi 提供了从轻到重三档改造方式，按你的需求选：

### 轻量：写一个 Skill

最简单的扩展。在 `~/.agents/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md` 写一个 markdown，描述某类任务的标准流程。模型会按需加载它。本仓库的 `chrome-devtools` skill 就是这种形式。

适合：沉淀「怎么调试某个框架」「怎么发版」这类流程知识，零代码。

### 中量：装 / 写 MCP Server

MCP（Model Context Protocol）是跨 agent 的工具协议。你写一个 MCP server（任何语言），在 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json` 注册，Pi 通过 `pi-mcp-adapter` 把它的工具接进来。本仓库的 `context7`、`chrome-devtools` 两个 MCP 就是这么接的。

适合：接入外部服务（数据库、API、浏览器、文档源），工具跨 agent 复用。

### 重量：写一个 Extension

最强力的改造。创建 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/my-ext.ts`：

```typescript
import type { ExtensionAPI } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import { Type } from "typebox";

export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI) {
  // 拦截危险命令
  pi.on("tool_call", async (event, ctx) => {
    if (event.toolName === "bash" && event.input.command?.includes("rm -rf")) {
      const ok = await ctx.ui.confirm("危险!", "允许 rm -rf?");
      if (!ok) return { block: true, reason: "用户阻止" };
    }
  });

  // 注册自定义工具
  pi.registerTool({
    name: "greet",
    label: "Greet",
    description: "按名字打招呼",
    parameters: Type.Object({ name: Type.String() }),
    async execute(_id, params) {
      return { content: [{ type: "text", text: `Hello, ${params.name}!` }] };
    },
  });

  // 注册命令
  pi.registerCommand("hello", {
    description: "打招呼",
    handler: async (_args, ctx) => ctx.ui.notify("Hello!", "info"),
  });
}
```

测试：`pi -e ./my-ext.ts`；正式用放 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/` 然后 `/reload`。

适合：权限门禁、git checkpoint、自定义 compaction、外部集成、有状态工具。能订阅的事件覆盖了 session / agent / message / tool / model / provider 全生命周期。

### 打包分发

写好后加个 `package.json`，声明 `pi` manifest 和 `pi-package` 关键字，发到 npm 就成：

```json
{
  "name": "my-pi-ext",
  "keywords": ["pi-package"],
  "pi": { "extensions": ["./extensions"], "skills": ["./skills"] }
}
```

然后 `pi install npm:my-pi-ext`，别人就能用你的扩展了。

---

## 五、快速上手（3 步）

```bash
# 1. 克隆本仓库
git clone https://github.com/realchendahuang/pi-config.git
cd pi-config

# 2. 一键安装（装 17 个插件 + 合并 MCP 配置）
bash install.sh

# 3. 重启 pi，让所有插件和 MCP server 生效
```

脚本会自动把 17 个插件用 `pi install` 装好，并把 2 个 MCP server 的配置合并进 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json`（如果该文件已存在，会保留你已有的 server，只做合并）。

> 安装完之后，模型的 provider / key 还需要你自己用 `pi config` 配一下——这部分因人而异，不在本仓库范围内。

---

## 六、插件目录（17 个，按用途分组）

下面逐个讲清楚每个插件是干嘛的、为什么选它，并附上仓库地址方便你深挖。

### 🤖 代理编排与工作流

#### `pi-subagents`

子代理委派框架。让主代理可以把任务派给子代理，支持五种工作模式：

- **single**：单个子代理独立完成一个任务
- **chain**：多个子代理串成流水线，前一个的输出喂给后一个
- **parallel**：多个子代理并行跑同一类任务
- **async**：后台异步执行，完成后通知
- **forked-context**：从父会话 fork 出独立上下文

适合做「先让一个代理研究、再让另一个代理实现、最后让第三个代理 review」这种复杂流程。配带一个 `pi-subagents` skill 教模型怎么编排。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-subagents>

#### `@narumitw/pi-goal`

目标驱动模式。用 `/goal` 设一个目标，Pi 会自主推进直到完成，中途遇到阻塞会主动停下来等你。适合那种「给我做完这个 feature」的长任务。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `@narumitw/pi-plan-mode`

只读的计划模式（类似 Codex 的 read-only collaboration）。让模型先出方案、跟你讨论清楚，再进入执行。避免一上来就乱改文件。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

### 🔍 代码智能与上下文管理

#### `pi-lens`

Pi 的「IDE 眼睛」。给 Pi 加上 AST 级别的代码理解能力：

- 基于 **ast-grep** 的结构化搜索 / 替换（比纯文本 grep 精准）
- 基于 **tree-sitter** 的语法规则检查
- **LSP 诊断**：跑构建前主动查类型错误
- 符号搜索、模块报告、读符号体等「廉价读代码」工具

配套 4 个 skill：`pi-lens-ast-grep`、`pi-lens-lsp-navigation`、`pi-lens-write-ast-grep-rule`、`pi-lens-write-tree-sitter-rule`（教你写自定义规则）。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/apmantza/pi-lens>

#### `context-mode`

省 token 的核心插件。把大输出（日志、构建结果、网页内容、git diff 等）路由进一个沙箱，用代码处理，只把摘要返回给模型。内置一个 **FTS5 全文检索知识库**，可以索引文档、网页、历史会话，之后按需检索。

效果：分析 47 个源文件，直接 read 要烧 ~700KB 上下文；走 context-mode 只回 ~3.6KB。配套 8 个 skill（ctx-search / ctx-index / ctx-stats / ctx-purge / ctx-insight / ctx-doctor / ctx-upgrade / context-mode 本体）。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode>

#### `pi-hermes-memory`

跨会话记忆。让 Pi 记住你之前告诉过它的事（你的偏好、项目约定、之前踩过的坑），下次开新会话还能用上。记忆分 user / memory / project / failure 四类，可搜索。默认基于策略的 token 感知记忆，带 SQLite FTS5 检索 + 自动合并。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/chandra447/pi-hermes-memory>

### 🌐 浏览、检索与外部接入

#### `pi-web-access`

Web 访问全家桶：

- **web_search**：多引擎网页搜索（OpenAI / Brave / Exa / Tavily / Perplexity / Gemini）
- **fetch_content**：抓 URL 内容转 markdown，支持 YouTube 转录、GitHub 仓库克隆、PDF 提取、本地视频抽帧
- 配带 `librarian` skill：带 GitHub 永链的库研究，适合深挖某个开源库的内部实现
- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-web-access>

#### `pi-playwright`

Playwright 浏览器自动化。让 Pi 能开浏览器、填表单、点按钮、截图、查 console / network。配带 `playwright-browser` skill。适合测 Web 应用、做端到端自动化。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/guwidoe/pi-playwright>

#### `pi-mcp-adapter`

MCP（Model Context Protocol）适配器。让 Pi 能连接任何 MCP server，把它的工具接进来。本仓库的 2 个 MCP server 就是通过它生效的。支持 OAuth、安全审查、按需懒启动。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-mcp-adapter>

#### `pi-marketplace`

Pi 包市场入口。在 Pi 里直接搜索、查看详情、安全审计、安装 npm 上的 pi 包。配套 `marketplace_search` / `marketplace_detail` / `marketplace_audit` / `marketplace_install` 工具。发现新插件很方便。

- 📦 仓库：<https://pi.dev/packages/pi-marketplace>

### ✨ 实用工具与主题

#### `@juicesharp/rpiv-todo`

给模型的 todo list，渲染成实时浮层，**扛得住 `/reload` 和会话压缩**。多步骤任务进度可视化，不容易跑偏。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/juicesharp/rpiv-mono>

#### `@narumitw/pi-statusline`

状态栏增强。替换 Pi 默认 footer，在底部显示模型、上下文占用、git 状态等更丰富的信息，一眼看清当前状态。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `@narumitw/pi-github-pr`

在 Pi 里看 GitHub PR 的 review / checks / comment 状态，不用切浏览器。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `pi-simplify`

审最近改动的代码，从清晰度、一致性、可维护性角度给建议。改完代码跑一下，把烂味道扫干净。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/MattDevy/pi-extensions>

#### `@firstpick/pi-prompts-git-pr`

一套可复用的 prompt 模板：提交信息、PR 描述、PR review 流程。直接 `/` 唤起对应模板，省得每次手敲。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/Firstp1ck/pi-coding-agent-forge>

#### `@firstpick/pi-skill-deep-research`

带 `deep-research` skill：两阶段严谨研究流程，带 schema / policy 校验。适合需要多源证据、事实核查的高 stakes 研究。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/Firstp1ck/pi-coding-agent-forge>

#### `@victor-software-house/pi-curated-themes`

精选暗色终端主题集（从 iTerm2-Color-Schemes 迁移），含我用的 `github-dark-colorblind`。还带 `adapt-ghostty-theme-to-pi` skill：把 Ghostty 终端主题迁移成 Pi 主题。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/victor-software-house/pi-curated-themes>

## 八、MCP Server（2 个）

配置在 `mcp.json`，安装脚本会合并到 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json`。

### `context7`

Upstash 的 Context7 MCP。给模型实时拉取第三方库的**最新文档**，避免它用过时的训练知识写代码。

```json
{
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp@latest"],
  "lifecycle": "lazy"
}
```

### `chrome-devtools`

Chrome DevTools 远程控制，29 个工具（点击、截图、网络抓包、性能分析等）。配合 `chrome-devtools` skill 调试网页很顺手。

> 这个 server 需要本地装一个 `chrome-devtools-mcp` 二进制，路径在 `mcp.json` 里是写死的，换机器后请改成你自己的路径。

两个都设了 `"lifecycle": "lazy"`——按需启动，不常驻，省资源。

## 一、Pi 是什么？

[Pi](https://pi.dev)（npm 包 `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`）是一个开源的终端 AI 编码代理。你给它一个任务，它在你本地的项目里读写文件、跑命令、调用工具来完成任务。

如果你还没装 Pi，先：

```bash
npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
```

然后跑 `pi` 进入交互界面。本仓库的所有插件都假设你已经有一个能正常工作的 Pi。

---

## 二、Pi 的整体架构

理解架构有助于你挑选和编写插件。Pi 是一个**插件驱动的代理循环**，核心分层：

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  TUI / RPC / Print   ← 用户交互层（终端界面 / API）  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Agent Loop          ← 代理循环：收 prompt → 调模型  │
│                         → 执行工具 → 回传结果         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Providers / Models  ← 多模型抽象：OpenAI / Anthropic │
│                         / 本地 / 自定义 provider      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Tools               ← 模型可调用的工具：bash/read/   │
│                         edit/web_search/mcp/自定义    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Extensions          ← TypeScript 模块，能订阅事件、  │
│                         注册工具/命令/快捷键/主题      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Skills / Prompts    ← Markdown 形式的「过程知识」，  │
│                         按需注入到模型上下文           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Themes              ← JSON 配色方案                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Packages            ← 上面这些资源的分发单位          │
│                         （npm / git / 本地路径）       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**关键概念：**

- **Extension（扩展）**：TypeScript 模块，最强力的改造方式。能订阅生命周期事件（如 `tool_call` 可以拦截/修改/阻止工具调用）、注册自定义工具、注册命令、改系统提示词、自定义渲染。
- **Skill（技能）**：一个 `SKILL.md` 文件，描述「某类任务怎么做」。模型按需加载，跨会话存活。Pi 实现了 [Agent Skills 标准](https://agentskills.io/specification)，所以 Claude Code / OpenAI Codex 的 skill 也能直接用。
- **Prompt（提示模板）**：可复用的 `.md` 模板，用 `/template` 唤起。
- **Theme（主题）**：JSON 配色文件。
- **Package（包）**：把上面这些打包，通过 npm / git / 本地路径分发。`pi install` 就是装包。

**代理循环的大致流程：**

1. 用户输入 prompt
2. `before_agent_start` 事件（扩展可注入消息 / 改系统提示词）
3. 进入 turn 循环：调模型 → 模型可能调用工具 → `tool_call` 事件（可拦截）→ 执行工具 → `tool_result` 事件（可改结果）→ 回传给模型
4. 模型不再调工具 → `agent_end` → `agent_settled`

扩展可以挂在任何一个环节上。

---

## 三、Pi 的生态与包市场

### 包市场（pi.dev/packages）

Pi 有一个官方的 [包市场](https://pi.dev/packages)，所有在 `package.json` 里带 `pi-package` 关键字的 npm 包都会自动出现在上面。每个包页面会展示版本、下载量、依赖、仓库链接、甚至 demo 视频/截图。

在 Pi 里也可以直接搜包：

```bash
# 用 pi-marketplace 扩展（本仓库已装）
# 或命令行：
pi install npm:@some/package
```

### 三种包来源

| 来源 | 格式 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm | `npm:@scope/pkg@1.2.3` | 最常见，版本可 pin |
| git | `git:github.com/user/repo@v1` | 适合私有 / 未发布的包，SSH/HTTPS 都行 |
| 本地路径 | `/abs/path` 或 `./rel/path` | 开发调试用 |

### 配置文件位置

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` | 全局设置：packages 列表、主题、默认模型等 |
| `~/.pi/agent/tools.json` | 工具开关：哪些工具 active / inactive |
| `~/.pi/agent/models.json` | provider 和模型定义 |
| `~/.pi/agent/extensions/*.ts` | 全局自定义扩展（auto-discover，支持 `/reload`） |
| `~/.agents/skills/` | 全局自定义 skill |
| `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json` | MCP server 配置 |
| `.pi/settings.json` | 项目级设置（可跟团队共享） |
| `.pi/extensions/` | 项目级扩展 |

---

## 四、如何改造 / 扩展 Pi

Pi 提供了从轻到重三档改造方式，按你的需求选：

### 轻量：写一个 Skill

最简单的扩展。在 `~/.agents/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md` 写一个 markdown，描述某类任务的标准流程。模型会按需加载它。本仓库的 `chrome-devtools` skill 就是这种形式。

适合：沉淀「怎么调试某个框架」「怎么发版」这类流程知识，零代码。

### 中量：装 / 写 MCP Server

MCP（Model Context Protocol）是跨 agent 的工具协议。你写一个 MCP server（任何语言），在 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json` 注册，Pi 通过 `pi-mcp-adapter` 把它的工具接进来。本仓库的 `context7`、`chrome-devtools` 两个 MCP 就是这么接的。

适合：接入外部服务（数据库、API、浏览器、文档源），工具跨 agent 复用。

### 重量：写一个 Extension

最强力的改造。创建 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/my-ext.ts`：

```typescript
import type { ExtensionAPI } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import { Type } from "typebox";

export default function (pi: ExtensionAPI) {
  // 拦截危险命令
  pi.on("tool_call", async (event, ctx) => {
    if (event.toolName === "bash" && event.input.command?.includes("rm -rf")) {
      const ok = await ctx.ui.confirm("危险!", "允许 rm -rf?");
      if (!ok) return { block: true, reason: "用户阻止" };
    }
  });

  // 注册自定义工具
  pi.registerTool({
    name: "greet",
    label: "Greet",
    description: "按名字打招呼",
    parameters: Type.Object({ name: Type.String() }),
    async execute(_id, params) {
      return { content: [{ type: "text", text: `Hello, ${params.name}!` }] };
    },
  });

  // 注册命令
  pi.registerCommand("hello", {
    description: "打招呼",
    handler: async (_args, ctx) => ctx.ui.notify("Hello!", "info"),
  });
}
```

测试：`pi -e ./my-ext.ts`；正式用放 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/` 然后 `/reload`。

适合：权限门禁、git checkpoint、自定义 compaction、外部集成、有状态工具。能订阅的事件覆盖了 session / agent / message / tool / model / provider 全生命周期。

### 打包分发

写好后加个 `package.json`，声明 `pi` manifest 和 `pi-package` 关键字，发到 npm 就成：

```json
{
  "name": "my-pi-ext",
  "keywords": ["pi-package"],
  "pi": { "extensions": ["./extensions"], "skills": ["./skills"] }
}
```

然后 `pi install npm:my-pi-ext`，别人就能用你的扩展了。

---

## 五、快速上手（3 步）

```bash
# 1. 克隆本仓库
git clone https://github.com/realchendahuang/pi-config.git
cd pi-config

# 2. 一键安装（装 17 个插件 + 合并 MCP 配置）
bash install.sh

# 3. 重启 pi，让所有插件和 MCP server 生效
```

脚本会自动把 17 个插件用 `pi install` 装好，并把 2 个 MCP server 的配置合并进 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json`（如果该文件已存在，会保留你已有的 server，只做合并）。

> 安装完之后，模型的 provider / key 还需要你自己用 `pi config` 配一下——这部分因人而异，不在本仓库范围内。

---

## 六、插件目录（17 个，按用途分组）

下面逐个讲清楚每个插件是干嘛的、为什么选它，并附上仓库地址方便你深挖。

### 🤖 代理编排与工作流

#### `pi-subagents`

子代理委派框架。让主代理可以把任务派给子代理，支持五种工作模式：

- **single**：单个子代理独立完成一个任务
- **chain**：多个子代理串成流水线，前一个的输出喂给后一个
- **parallel**：多个子代理并行跑同一类任务
- **async**：后台异步执行，完成后通知
- **forked-context**：从父会话 fork 出独立上下文

适合做「先让一个代理研究、再让另一个代理实现、最后让第三个代理 review」这种复杂流程。配带一个 `pi-subagents` skill 教模型怎么编排。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-subagents>

#### `@narumitw/pi-goal`

目标驱动模式。用 `/goal` 设一个目标，Pi 会自主推进直到完成，中途遇到阻塞会主动停下来等你。适合那种「给我做完这个 feature」的长任务。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `@narumitw/pi-plan-mode`

只读的计划模式（类似 Codex 的 read-only collaboration）。让模型先出方案、跟你讨论清楚，再进入执行。避免一上来就乱改文件。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

### 🔍 代码智能与上下文管理

#### `pi-lens`

Pi 的「IDE 眼睛」。给 Pi 加上 AST 级别的代码理解能力：

- 基于 **ast-grep** 的结构化搜索 / 替换（比纯文本 grep 精准）
- 基于 **tree-sitter** 的语法规则检查
- **LSP 诊断**：跑构建前主动查类型错误
- 符号搜索、模块报告、读符号体等「廉价读代码」工具

配套 4 个 skill：`pi-lens-ast-grep`、`pi-lens-lsp-navigation`、`pi-lens-write-ast-grep-rule`、`pi-lens-write-tree-sitter-rule`（教你写自定义规则）。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/apmantza/pi-lens>

#### `context-mode`

省 token 的核心插件。把大输出（日志、构建结果、网页内容、git diff 等）路由进一个沙箱，用代码处理，只把摘要返回给模型。内置一个 **FTS5 全文检索知识库**，可以索引文档、网页、历史会话，之后按需检索。

效果：分析 47 个源文件，直接 read 要烧 ~700KB 上下文；走 context-mode 只回 ~3.6KB。配套 8 个 skill（ctx-search / ctx-index / ctx-stats / ctx-purge / ctx-insight / ctx-doctor / ctx-upgrade / context-mode 本体）。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode>

#### `pi-hermes-memory`

跨会话记忆。让 Pi 记住你之前告诉过它的事（你的偏好、项目约定、之前踩过的坑），下次开新会话还能用上。记忆分 user / memory / project / failure 四类，可搜索。默认基于策略的 token 感知记忆，带 SQLite FTS5 检索 + 自动合并。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/chandra447/pi-hermes-memory>

### 🌐 浏览、检索与外部接入

#### `pi-web-access`

Web 访问全家桶：

- **web_search**：多引擎网页搜索（OpenAI / Brave / Exa / Tavily / Perplexity / Gemini）
- **fetch_content**：抓 URL 内容转 markdown，支持 YouTube 转录、GitHub 仓库克隆、PDF 提取、本地视频抽帧
- 配带 `librarian` skill：带 GitHub 永链的库研究，适合深挖某个开源库的内部实现
- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-web-access>

#### `pi-playwright`

Playwright 浏览器自动化。让 Pi 能开浏览器、填表单、点按钮、截图、查 console / network。配带 `playwright-browser` skill。适合测 Web 应用、做端到端自动化。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/guwidoe/pi-playwright>

#### `pi-mcp-adapter`

MCP（Model Context Protocol）适配器。让 Pi 能连接任何 MCP server，把它的工具接进来。本仓库的 2 个 MCP server 就是通过它生效的。支持 OAuth、安全审查、按需懒启动。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-mcp-adapter>

#### `pi-marketplace`

Pi 包市场入口。在 Pi 里直接搜索、查看详情、安全审计、安装 npm 上的 pi 包。配套 `marketplace_search` / `marketplace_detail` / `marketplace_audit` / `marketplace_install` 工具。发现新插件很方便。

- 📦 仓库：<https://pi.dev/packages/pi-marketplace>

### ✨ 实用工具与主题

#### `@juicesharp/rpiv-todo`

给模型的 todo list，渲染成实时浮层，**扛得住 `/reload` 和会话压缩**。多步骤任务进度可视化，不容易跑偏。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/juicesharp/rpiv-mono>

#### `@narumitw/pi-statusline`

状态栏增强。替换 Pi 默认 footer，在底部显示模型、上下文占用、git 状态等更丰富的信息，一眼看清当前状态。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `@narumitw/pi-github-pr`

在 Pi 里看 GitHub PR 的 review / checks / comment 状态，不用切浏览器。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions>

#### `pi-simplify`

审最近改动的代码，从清晰度、一致性、可维护性角度给建议。改完代码跑一下，把烂味道扫干净。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/MattDevy/pi-extensions>

#### `@firstpick/pi-prompts-git-pr`

一套可复用的 prompt 模板：提交信息、PR 描述、PR review 流程。直接 `/` 唤起对应模板，省得每次手敲。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/Firstp1ck/pi-coding-agent-forge>

#### `@firstpick/pi-skill-deep-research`

带 `deep-research` skill：两阶段严谨研究流程，带 schema / policy 校验。适合需要多源证据、事实核查的高 stakes 研究。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/Firstp1ck/pi-coding-agent-forge>

#### `@victor-software-house/pi-curated-themes`

精选暗色终端主题集（从 iTerm2-Color-Schemes 迁移），含我用的 `github-dark-colorblind`。还带 `adapt-ghostty-theme-to-pi` skill：把 Ghostty 终端主题迁移成 Pi 主题。

- 📦 仓库：<https://github.com/victor-software-house/pi-curated-themes>

---

## 七、全局 Skill 清单（18 个）

所有 skill 都是全局的——装了包就处处可用，跟当前在哪个项目无关。

| 类别 | Skill | 来源包 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 研究/浏览 | `librarian`、`deep-research`、`chrome-devtools` | pi-web-access / @firstpick / 自定义 |
| 浏览器 | `playwright-browser` | pi-playwright |
| 上下文/知识库 | `context-mode`、`ctx-search`、`ctx-index`、`ctx-stats`、`ctx-purge`、`ctx-insight`、`ctx-doctor`、`ctx-upgrade` | context-mode |
| 代码智能 | `pi-lens-ast-grep`、`pi-lens-lsp-navigation`、`pi-lens-write-ast-grep-rule`、`pi-lens-write-tree-sitter-rule` | pi-lens |
| 代理编排 | `pi-subagents` | pi-subagents |
| 主题 | `adapt-ghostty-theme-to-pi` | @victor-software-house |

> 其中 `chrome-devtools` 是我放在 `~/.agents/skills/` 的自定义全局 skill，不在任何 npm 包里，需要自己创建（参考第二节「写一个 Skill」）。

---

## 八、MCP Server（2 个）

配置在 `mcp.json`，安装脚本会合并到 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json`。

### `context7`

Upstash 的 Context7 MCP。给模型实时拉取第三方库的**最新文档**，避免它用过时的训练知识写代码。

```json
{
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp@latest"],
  "lifecycle": "lazy"
}
```

### `chrome-devtools`

Chrome DevTools 远程控制，29 个工具（点击、截图、网络抓包、性能分析等）。配合 `chrome-devtools` skill 调试网页很顺手。

> 这个 server 需要本地装一个 `chrome-devtools-mcp` 二进制，路径在 `mcp.json` 里是写死的，换机器后请改成你自己的路径。

两个都设了 `"lifecycle": "lazy"`——按需启动，不常驻，省资源。

---

## 九、仓库内容

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `install.sh` | 一键安装脚本：装 17 个插件 + 合并 MCP 配置 |
| `config.json` | 机器可读的完整配置（plugins / globalSkills / mcpServers / UI / tools） |
| `mcp.json` | MCP server 配置，可直接放到 `~/.config/mcp/mcp.json` |
| `README.md` | 本文件 |

---

## 十、装完之后怎么用

1. **先配模型**：跑 `pi config`，加你自己的 provider 和模型。本仓库不涉及这部分。
2. **重启 Pi**：让新装的插件和 MCP server 生效。
3. **试试 skill**：在 Pi 里直接描述任务，模型会自动匹配合适的 skill；也可以用 `/context-mode:ctx-stats` 这类斜杠命令手动调。
4. **调工具开关**（可选）：Pi 的 `tools.json` 可以把不常用工具设为 inactive，保持工具列表干净。我个人的做法是把 `ast_grep_*` / `grep` / `find` / `ls` / `lsp_navigation` 设为 inactive，需要时通过 `pi_lens_activate_tools` 按需唤起。`config.json` 里有我的完整 tools 配置可参考。

---

repository.readme:
Quickstart · Prompt Library · Browser Dev URLs · Design System & Styleguide · 7-Stage Workflow · Documentation

--- EmDash is a modern, lightweight headless CMS built ground-up for AI-native web development. Baseline provides the visual frontend foundation, development guardrails, and testing harness built specifically for developers pairing with AI coding assistants—whether using **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, **Google Antigravity**, **OpenCode / OMP**, **Hermes**, **Cursor**, **Windsurf**, **Aider**, or local LLM runners. Spend your time building the site, not debugging agent hallucinations or wrestling with styling drift. Baseline gives your AI assistant clear architectural boundaries, an agent-first token & WCAG contrast engine (`npm run design:tokens`), and a living component quarantine canvas (`/_styleguide`) to stress-test reusable components in isolation before assembling templates. Start locally with Node and SQLite, catch schema-width problems early, and deploy with confidence. --- ## ⚡ 60-Second Quickstart **Requirements:** Node 22.22.2 minimum (Node 24 LTS recommended) and `npm`. ```sh # 1. Clone the repository and install dependencies git clone https://github.com/Vermeulen-Solutions/emdash-baseline.git my-site cd my-site npm install # 2. Generate initial encryption secrets and start local dev server npx emdash secrets generate --write .env npm run dev ``` ### 🖥️ Where to look in your browser Once `npm run dev` is running, open these local URLs: | Destination | Local URL | What it's for | | --- | --- | --- | | 🌐 **Public Site** | [`http://localhost:4321/`](http://localhost:4321/) | Live website rendered by Astro | | ✏️ **CMS Admin** | [`http://localhost:4321/_emdash/admin`](http://localhost:4321/_emdash/admin) | Create your admin account, manage collections, and edit content | | 🧪 **Component Styleguide** | [`http://localhost:4321/_styleguide`](http://localhost:4321/_styleguide) | Stress-test layout primitives and calibrate typography/spacing (404 in production) | --- ## 🤖 Pairing with Your AI Assistant Baseline is harness-agnostic. Whether pairing with **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, **Google Antigravity**, **Cursor**, **Windsurf**, or **Aider**, you never have to guess what to prompt. ### 📋 Starter Prompt: Kick Off a New Site Paste this exact prompt into your AI assistant to start: ```markdown Read AGENTS.md, follow new-site-workflow under .agents/skills/, and guide me through the staged delivery workflow. Here is the context for this project: - Client / Brand: [Brand Name] - Purpose: [E.g., B2B marketing site / Portfolio / Directory] - Target Audience: [E.g., Enterprise buyers / General public] - Locales: [E.g., Single language (en) or Multilingual (en, fr)] Please begin with Stage 1 (Brief & Evidence Discovery) and present the Stage 1 handoff choices once complete. ``` ### 📚 Ready-to-Copy Prompt Recipes Need to run a specific task? Copy battle-tested prompt templates directly from our prompt playbook: 👉 **[Open the AI Developer Prompt Library (`docs/prompt-library.md`)](docs/prompt-library.md)** - 🚀 [Kickstarting a Greenfield Site](docs/prompt-library.md#1-starting-a-new-site-project) - 🗄️ [Auditing WordPress Content & Finding Hidden Entities](docs/prompt-library.md#2-wordpress-migration--content-modeling) - 🖼️ [Manifest-Driven WordPress Media Ingestion](docs/prompt-library.md#2-wordpress-migration--content-modeling) - 🎨 [Art Direction & The Design Gate](docs/prompt-library.md#3-art-direction--the-design-gate) - 📦 [Quarantining Tailwind Blueprints (21st.dev to Zero-JS Astro)](docs/prompt-library.md#4-component-sourcing--styleguide-quarantine) - ✏️ [Wiring EmDash Live Edit Proxies](docs/prompt-library.md#5-public-pages--emdash-editorial-canvas) - 🔍 [Bounded UI/UX Polish with Impeccable Critique](docs/prompt-library.md#6-visual-polish--the-impeccable-critique) - 📸 [Local Visual Regression Testing (`npm run test:visual`)](docs/prompt-library.md#7-local-visual-regression--pre-launch-checks) - 🛡️ [Cloudflare Cutover & Corporate Email DNS Safety](docs/prompt-library.md#8-production-cutover--corporate-email-safety) To connect your coding assistant directly to EmDash's built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing content and schema, generate a token in one step: ```sh npm run mcp:token ``` See [agent documentation](docs/agent-documentation.md) for harness integration and MCP setup across all major tools. --- ## Agent-First Design System & Component Quarantine Instead of manual browser sliders or disconnected GUI overrides, Baseline treats `AGENTS.md`, `DESIGN.md`, and `src/styles/global.css` as a single, code-first pipeline verified automatically by CLI and live on `/_styleguide`:

| Capability | Command / Route | How your AI agent uses it | | --- | --- | --- | | **Aesthetic Lane Presets** | `npm run design:tokens -- --list-lanes` | Seed any canonical Aesthetic Lane (`technical-systems`, `product-led-minimalism`, `editorial-paper`, `luminous-futurism`, `neutral`) into `src/styles/global.css` via `--lane --write` before customizing brand hues and fonts | | **WCAG Contrast & Fluid Audit** | `npm run design:tokens` | Parses `src/styles/global.css` directly and verifies 10 WCAG AA perceptual contrast pairs across default and `[data-surface="dark"]` contexts, fluid `clamp()` bounds, and styleguide specimen coverage | | **DESIGN.md Interchange** | `npm run design:check` / `design:export` | Import or export portable `DESIGN.md` specifications compatible with Google Stitch, Claude Design, OpenDesign, and [designmd.ai](https://designmd.ai/explore) | | **Component Quarantine** | `http://localhost:4321/_styleguide` | Stress-test typography, OKLCH swatches, native controls, ``, ``, and galleries with instant Vite HMR (automatically returns 404 in production) | | **Optional Visual Page Builder** | `@perkyzz/emvb` + `@perkyzz/emvb-mcp` | For sites that need editor-built drag-and-drop campaign landing pages or popups alongside structured Astro templates, connect EmVB with `canvasStyles` bridged to `src/styles/global.css` ([Design Framework Guide](docs/design-framework.md)) | --- ## The 7-stage site delivery workflow Pairing with an AI coding assistant without a structured process usually results in "one-shot prompt chaos"—where an assistant attempts to do discovery, database schema, responsive layouts, and copy all at once, resulting in broken schemas and generic styling. `, ``, auto-fit ``, and accessible `` (`--card-*` tokens, concentric radii, and `.clickable-parent`/`.focus-parent`) adapt to any screen width without media queries. The default runtime is **Node + SQLite + local media**, with no cloud account needed. Cloudflare Workers is an optional site-specific target; its adapter, D1/R2 bindings and image delivery need separate setup and verification. When deploying to Cloudflare or switching nameservers, always follow the DNS checklist to preserve client corporate email. Baseline changes require an explicit, reviewed `--update`. ### 🤖 Keep AI coding assistants disciplined and on rails Building client sites with AI coding assistants—across any harness or tool runner—is fast, but assistants often struggle with headless CMS architectures. Without clear constraints, they tend to invent unnecessary wrapper components, hardcode text that clients should be able to edit in the CMS, or introduce subtle layout breaks on mobile viewports. Baseline includes a structured workflow designed to keep coding assistants disciplined and aligned with the site's architecture: - **Art direction gates before implementation:** Before writing visual code, the agent is directed to record aesthetic decisions in `AGENTS.md` (typography pairings, spatial density, and anti-patterns). - **Automated token & WCAG contrast verification:** `npm run design:tokens` checks semantic token completeness, OKLCH/hex contrast ratios across light and dark surfaces, and fluid `clamp()` scales. - **CMS editorial preservation:** Guidance in `.agents/skills/` explicitly defines EmDash's row-per-locale structure and field-proxy attributes (`data-emdash-ref`). - **Component quarantine (`/_styleguide`):** The workflow directs the agent to calibrate reusable primitives and responsive edge cases in isolation on `/_styleguide` first. - **Fast, self-verifying feedback loops:** `check:schema-budget`, `design:tokens`, `test:visual`, fast unit tests, and typechecking run locally in seconds. - **Maintainable specialist skills:** Guidance is modularized into specialist skills under `.agents/skills/` that can be updated from upstream via `npm run sync:site-skills` without overwriting project instructions. [Agent setup guide](docs/agent-documentation.md). --- ## Where to work (project layout) | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `src/pages/` | Server-rendered public routes (`/`, `/about`, `/posts/[slug]`, `/_styleguide`) | | `src/layouts/Base.astro` | Core layout shell, EmDash live-editing script, and header/footer | | `src/components/` | Reusable layout primitives (`Section`, `Container`, `Grid`, `Card`, `LogoTicker`) | | `src/styles/global.css` | Neutral Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens, typography, and base rules | | `seed/seed.json` | Initial Posts/Pages schema and starter content | | `src/live.config.ts` | EmDash live collection registration | | `astro.config.mjs` | Astro configuration (Node adapter, EmDash SQLite setup, Tailwind v4) | | `.agents/skills/` | Modular specialist skills for AI coding agents | | `docs/` | Complete documentation guides (see [docs/README.md](docs/README.md)) | --- ## Daily commands | Command | Use it for | | --- | --- | | `npm run dev` | Develop the site and open `/_styleguide` | | `npm run design:tokens` | Audit tokens, WCAG contrast pairs, and fluid scales in `src/styles/global.css` (or apply a lane preset) | | `npm run test:design` | Validate art direction record, token coverage, and `DESIGN.md` interchange | | `npm run typecheck` | Astro/TypeScript diagnostics and schema preflight | | `npm run check:schema-budget` | Measure the local database's physical collection widths | | `npm run db:diff` | Compare offline SQLite/D1 schema parity and column budgets | | `npm run media:migrate-wp` | Manifest-driven WordPress media preparation, CMS ingestion, and R2 staging | | `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` | Run the unit and tooling tests | | `npm run test:visual` | Compare local Windows captures with reviewed baselines | | `npm run check:dev-tools` | Verify `/_styleguide` and fixture markers stay out of production | | `npm run build` | Build the Node production artifact | | `npm run start:local` | Run that artifact with your local `.env` | | `npm run audit:site -- --root ../my-site` | Diagnose a downstream repository without changing it | | `npm run check:upstream` | Review Astro, adapters, EmDash and Node version updates | Browser tests need the exact renderer described in [visual regression setup](docs/visual-regression.md). CI uses one Node version for fast checks and a normal build; screenshot comparisons remain local. --- ## Build with content, not around it Use the neutral Tailwind v4 tokens and small `Section`, `Container` and `Grid` primitives as your starting API. Keep editorial content in EmDash, forward field attributes to the stored value being rendered, and verify save/reload before handoff. Put site imagery in `src/assets/` or EmDash Media Library so native processing and ownership stay clear. [Component quarantine](.agents/skills/astro-site-design/references/component-quarantine.md) · [Editorial canvas](docs/emdash-editorial-canvas.md) · [Gallery workflow](docs/gallery-workflow.md) · [Image delivery](docs/image-delivery.md). The default runtime is **Node + SQLite + local media**, with no cloud account needed. Cloudflare Workers is an optional site-specific target; its adapter, D1/R2 bindings and image delivery need separate setup and verification. When deploying to Cloudflare or switching nameservers, always follow the DNS checklist to preserve client corporate email. [Production Deployment & DNS Checklist](docs/production-deployment.md) · [Hosting setup](.agents/skills/emdash-site-setup/SKILL.md) · [Supported standards and roadmap](standards/releases/0.1.1.md) · [Downstream audits](docs/site-standards-audit.md). --- ## Contribute [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) explains verification and upstream skill ownership. Baseline's own contributions use the [MIT license](LICENSE); bundled materials retain their [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Participation follows the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
